```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pdftools)
```

```{r}
fpath <- "/Users/divijsinha/Documents/projects/india-elections/data/pdf/ls/2024/karnataka/27561718701519.pdf"
text_read <- pdf_data(fpath, font_info = T) ## text_read is a list of pages
pg1 <- text_read[[1]] ## get first page
```

```{r}
round_arbit <- function(x, t) {
    return(round(x / t) * t)
}


pg1 %>%
    filter(
        font_size > 5.1,
        font_size < 6,
        font_name == "MPDFAA+DejaVuSerifCondensed-Bold"
    ) %>%
    filter(y > 156) %>%
    filter(x > 60, x < 683) %>%
    group_by(x) %>%
    mutate(x_center = round_arbit(mean(x) + (width / 2), 10)) %>%
    group_by(x_center) %>%
    arrange(y) %>%
    summarize(full_name = str_c(text, collapse = " ")) %>%
    print(n = 30)
```
